spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation of the Chapter of the Wheel

** ¶1. ** The ordered cycle of all knowledges of good and truth, which is here disclosed to the understanding , is a vast and powerful spiritual reality . It is one among four universal domains of governance within the mind, for the ruling love that commands every state of life is distributed across four provinces .

**¶2.** The first province consists of those aff ections and per ceptions that d well within the full ness of interior rational tru ths existing above the cycle of knowledges — that is, in the higher rational mind. The ruling love is held fast within these interior states, as though imprisoned in the heavenly regions of the understanding that are above.

**¶3 .** The second province consists of the natural states of the external mind that lie below. Four of these are composite states where good and evil, truth and falsity, are still interm ixed; and four are states of sh eer falsity and spiritual darkness. This second province extends from the conscious natural mind — the plane on which human thought and life proceed out ward ly — down ward into the lowest and most obsc ure regions of the natural .

**¶4.** The third province consists of the b ounding tru ths and containing forms that en close the whole spiritual world of the mind. These are the four elevated states of love and charity, and the three recept ive forms of celestial, spiritual, and natural truth, together with whatever aff ections and kn owledges d well within them, and the ruling love that is held capt ive within those forms, and the governing aff ections that exercise dominion over them.

** ¶5.** The fourth province is the ordered sphere of all knowledges, which has been arranged with the utmost care of Divine Providence, established according to a manif old order proce eding from the Divine Good and from the Divine Truth of the Lord.

**¶6 .** This sphere was arranged with such exact ness on account of the great and fierce evil aff ections, and the m onstrous forms of self -love and love of the world , that d well within it — these being held suspended in equilib rium within that order . For all the primary ev ils and the governing falsities from every domain of the mind — those that had their origin in the three provinces already named — were gathered together. They were collected, seized, bound, and assigned their place within this revol ving order of knowledges. Each was apport ioned from among the three provinces. They were distributed, int erwoven one with another, and each was counter balanced against its opposite of equal force .

**¶7.** And yet the ordered cycle of kn owledges is itself equal in power to the evil affections and falsities that are held within it. Indeed , they were suspended within the ever -turning sphere of spiritual knowledges precisely because of their destruct ive force — so that, by reason of the perpet ual spiritual influx and the c easeless change of states in which they revol ve, they cannot perce ive or fix upon the condition in which they are held. For if these hostile powers had been bound within the interior heav enly states, those states of wisdom would not have possessed the strength to sustain them. Again , if they had been assigned to the fixed natural states below, those exterior conditions also would not have had the strength to contain them. Rather, they were suspended within the revolving order of knowledges , so that whatever of good and wisdom is progress ively liberated from below — from the natural mind — may be received and conve yed up ward to the interior celest ial states above them . Conversely, whatever desc ends from the interior states above — whether the priv ation of love or the burning of self -love — the revol ving sphere of knowledges also receives it and casts it out across the whole natural mind and upon every perception .

**¶8.** Behold, the spiritual order of this cycle is of this form. For the evil affections int erwoven upon the sphere of knowledges are held in the manner of a ruling love that masters the whole mind by the organized power of all its governing affections; and by all the tru ths that serve as armor and defense , which have been gathered to it; and also by the vast accum ulation of all the mind 's poss essions; and by the all uring delights of natural affections that have been collected to it; together with all the natural goods and gentle affections that have been distributed among its subordin ate states. Yet if you inqu ire concerning that ruling love, it stands in perfect correspondence with all its subordinate affections. Its subordinate affections, for their part, stand in perfect correspondence with the whole mind. Disc ernment proceeds forth from that ruling love — the confir ming of truth and the rejection of fals ity — extending to every province of the mind, accomplished through its understanding , its intelligence, and the power of its will .

**¶9.** Now, just as this ruling love stands in correspondence with the full measure of its entire mind through understanding , intelligence, and the power of will , so it is also with the evil affections that are bound upon the sphere of knowledges in relation to the ruling love and the powers that exist throughout every region of the mind. As the ruling love stands toward its subordinate affections, so does this entire order gather itself to the sphere — to the seven governing goods in their fullness, and to the twelve complete states of faith and truth in their cycle . As all systems of doctrine are subordin ated to the ruling love, so again they are gathered to the governing principles of the whole mind. All that is accomplished in the interior and the exterior of the mind — the spiritual comb ats and the conf usions of thought and the bondage to evil and the deprivation of good and the burning of desire and the possessions of knowledge — all of these increase and diminish through these governing principles. They are the anim ating forces of the whole regener ate life , and all spiritual states are gathered into them.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: The wheel of the stars, which is displayed to you, is a great mighty thing! Also, it is one among the four great things; since the whole ruling-power is assigned to four parts.
The first part is the powers who occur in the ten firmaments that exist above the wheel, and the ruling-power that is bound in them, as it is imprisoned within them in the heavens that are above.

The second part is the eight earths that are below; the four that are composite, and the four places of darkness. The second part extends from this earth, upon which mankind walks, towards the underside.

The third part is the walls and the vessels that surround the worlds. They are the four mountains and the three vessels; with what is in them, and the ruling-power that is trapped within them, and the powers who are masters over them.

The fourth part is the sphere of the stars that is appointed with great diligence, as it is ordered in a [great m]any [ways by a twofold ordinance]; that of the Father of Life, [and that of the Mother of] the living.

Its [ordering is a] very [great matter, fashioned] with diligence, because of the great and cruel powers, and the titanic figures, [who are] in it; they being suspended from it. So, all the first-born and the leaders of all the rulers, they who were existing in the three parts, these were garnered. They were collected together, seized, bound and assigned on this wheel. Each was apportioned by these three parts. They were distributed, entwined, and weighted against their companions of the same size.

Still, for its part, the wheel is equal to them in its strength; the powers of the enmity who are bound on it. Indeed, they were suspended on the circling wheel because of their cruelty; so that, due to the wind and the motion in which they go round, they comprehend not the place wherein they are set. For if they had been bound in the heavens, the heavens would not have had the strength to support them. Again, if they had been assigned on the earths, on the fixtures that are below, they also would not have had the strength to support them. Rather, they were suspended from the wheel of the circling stars; so that the power and the light that should come up from below can be received, and given to the heavenly ones above them. Conversely, whatever will fall from above, whether cold or hot, the wheel of the sphere will also take it and cast it out upon the entire earth, upon all the wood.

Behold, the ordinance of the wheel is in this form. For the powers who are entwined on the wheel are like this: a king mastering his kingdom by this mighty legionary force of all the leaders of the kingdom; and with all the armour of the soldiery that is collected together for him; and also with the mass of the property of the kingdom; and the beautiful lustful aspect of the women who are collected together for him; together with [all the] property [of his lands,] and those cattle [and herds] that have been distributed about among his retinue. Yet, if you ask about that king, he is matched with all his retinue. His retinue, for its part, is matched against his entire kingdom. Judgement shall come forth from him, vindication and condemnation, to his entire kingdom; by his wisdom, skill and strength.

Now, just as for this king, who is matched against the measure of his entire kingdom by his wisdom, skill and strength; so also is it for the powers who are bound on the sphere as compared to the ruling-power, and the powers who exist in the entire zone. Like the king towards his retinue; so too is it that this totality is gathered to the sphere, to seven leaders, to twelve signs of the zodiac. As all the cities are gathered to the king, again they gather to the leaders of the universe. All that is done in the universe above and below: the battles and the disorders and the captivity and the hunger and the lust and the property; so shall they increase and diminish through these leaders. They are the motivaters of the whole created order; the totality being gathered in to them the way that I have told you. I have opened your eyes!
